description_en: Queries the information about snapshots that are created for a simple application server
description_zh: 查询一个或多个已创建的快照信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open list-snapshots --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id 2ad1ae67295445f598017499dc0000 --disk-id d-bp14wq0149cpp2xy0000 --snapshot-ids s-bp16oazlsold4dks0000_,_s-bp16oazlsold4abc0000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --source-disk-type Data --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-aek2bti7cf70000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSnapshots

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the simple application server that corresponds to the snapshots.
